name: load_tools
description: Activates one or more additional tools among those listed as available on request in the system prompt. Use it when the task needs a capability the currently active tools don't cover (e.g. searching the web, spawning a sub-agent, downloading a file). Activated tools stay available for the rest of the session, and their full parameters appear starting with your next reply: call them on the following turn, not this one.

names.description: Names of the tools to activate, exactly as they appear in the list of tools available on request. Ask for everything you need for the current phase in a single call.
